messages:
maria_g: deploybot paused the release (release-id: 2295) — staging/prod env parity check failed. Deploybot flagged: KV prefix mismatch for inference cache and keystore, and service token encoding differs (staging=hex, prod=base64). we have 40m left in the window. decision: backfill staging keystore or pin image and proceed?

deploybot: [automated] release 2295 paused: env.parity.kv_prefix_mismatch=true; details: resources affected: s3-inference-cache, keystore. service_token_encoding=hex(staging) vs base64(prod). canary_failures=2/3. rollback_allowed=true.

kevin_r: quick check -- looks like we rotated keystore in staging last week which bumped the prefix to `stg/inf/cache` vs prod `prod/inf/cache`. That explains the mismatch. Are the token formats actually incompatible or just naming?

carol_p: tagging @oncall_bot — do not promote with mismatched secrets. we saw "invalid token encoding" on canary logs.

maria_g: logs from canary:
```
ERROR inference-cache-warm: invalid token encoding for key stg/inf/cache: expected base64
WARN cache-warm: warming aborted for shard 3
```

kevin_r: we can either backfill staging keystore alias+encoding to match prod (convert hex->base64) or pin to previous runtime image that doesn't trigger the cache warm path. Backfill is low-risk but will change staging state. pin is fastest.

oncall_bot: current release window ends in ~40m. backfill + canary + 30m monitor would be tight but possible if we move fast. pin+promote is under 10m.

carol_p: product prefers feature in this window but not at the cost of flaking prod. I'd vote pin and follow up with a deeper fix and a backfill in the next maintenance window.

maria_g: agree. pin seems safer. we'll avoid touching keystore live in staging during a release window. kevin, can you prepare the pin and redeploy canary?

kevin_r: on it. will post commands and status here.

deploybot: [automated] release 2295 status: paused -> pending manual action by release manager.

kevin_r: running: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/infer-service inferd=registry.redwood/inferd:v1.32.1` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/infer-service -n inference --watch`

kevin_r: canary updated, rollout succeeded: 1/1 ready on canary. smoke tests passing. monitoring for 5m.

maria_g: thanks. please also add a follow-up ticket to align keystore prefixes (ENG-4478) and include steps to safely convert encodings.

kevin_r: ENG-4478 created and assigned to infra-keys. notes: "staging keystore uses hex-encoded token entries and a different kv prefix; need migration plan to prod style base64 + standard prefix."

maria_g: /unpause-release 2295 (manual unpause by release manager)

deploybot: [automated] release 2295 unpaused by maria_g. Promotion: canary -> success. :thumbsup:

oncall_bot: reminder: add a blurb to release notes and run postmortem: "staging/prod keystore prefix & encoding mismatch caused deploy pause; release pinned to v1.32.1; follow-up ENG-4478 scheduled."

carol_p: adding to release notes now. thanks everyone for quick turnaround.

maria_g: closing thread; we'll schedule a controlled backfill outside of release windows.
